description: Backfill per-unit rate fields in BillFee (feeUnitGrossValue, feeUnitValue, feeUnitMargin, feeUnitDiscount)
author: Dr M H B Ariyaratne
preRequisites: Run missing_database_fields.xhtml first to ensure the four feeUnit* columns exist in BILLFEE

migrationSteps.description: Detect actual BILLFEE and BILLITEM table names (handles MySQL case sensitivity)
Detect actual column names for feeGrossValue, feeValue, feeMargin, feeDiscount and the four new feeUnit* columns
Backfill feeUnitGrossValue = feeGrossValue / qty for all existing rows where feeUnitGrossValue IS NULL
Backfill feeUnitValue, feeUnitMargin, feeUnitDiscount the same way
